summary: Iter 12 backend validation of the 3 P0/P1 fixes shipped 2026-07-02. RESULT: 20/24 pytest tests PASS. 4 tests fail exposing a P0 REGRESSION in Fix 2 (VAD dynamic per audio_route): `dg_params_for_route()` sets `utterance_end_ms` to 700 (bluetooth), 800 (builtin/unknown) — but Deepgram Live enforces a HARD minimum of 1000ms on this parameter and returns HTTP 400 for any lower value. Live probe (see rca_of_issue) confirms 700/800/999 all fail; 1000/1500 both succeed. Consequence: STT is BROKEN in production for 3 of 4 audio routes (only `wired`=1000 works). Fix 1 (Whisper JSON parsing) and Fix 3 (Prosody unification) are both VERIFIED GREEN: (Fix 1) response_format='json', _extract_text() handles dict/str/pydantic-obj, anti-nested-JSON loop up to 3 iters, and the duplicate 0-arg _trigger_pipeline is REMOVED (single definition at voice_stream.py:786). (Fix 3) Live end-to-end run against /converse-fast/start with a 3-sentence prompt produced sentence_idx=0 (aggressive chunk ~22c) then sentence_idx=1 as a unified body significantly longer — confirms body_buffer is being accumulated and emitted as ONE TTS call. Also asserted no error events and clean done=true completion. Server starts clean, no import errors, no crashes.

critical.issue: P0 REGRESSION: Deepgram Live enforces `utterance_end_ms >= 1000ms` (server returns HTTP 400 for anything below). The new `dg_params_for_route()` in voice_stream.py:296-330 sets utterance_end_ms=700 for bluetooth and =800 for builtin/unknown, so `dg.connect()` fails on those routes with `server rejected WebSocket connection: HTTP 400`, the client receives `{'type':'error','message':'STT unavailable: ...HTTP 400'}` and the entire voice pipeline is dead. Only route=wired (1000ms) works. Live probe (5 values 700/800/999/1000/1500) confirms this deterministically. FIX: keep utterance_end_ms=1000 (min) for ALL routes; only vary `endpointing` (200/250/300) to achieve the intended aggressive-vs-conservative endpointing behavior. Endpointing has a much lower minimum (~10ms) and is the correct knob for tuning noisy/quiet audio contexts. Docs ref: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/utterance-end (Minimum: 1,000 ms).

rca_of_issue: REPRODUCTION: `python3 -c "...websockets.connect(wss://api.deepgram.com/v1/listen?...&utterance_end_ms=V&...)"` with V ∈ {700,800,999} → HTTP 400 from Deepgram before the WS handshake completes. With V ∈ {1000,1500} → 101 Switching Protocols, connection OK. Server-side log matches: `[KODA_STREAM_DG sess=XXXX] connected in 154ms — model=nova-3 lang=it endpointing=300ms utterance_end_ms=1000ms` (wired route, succeeds) vs `DG connect failed: server rejected WebSocket connection: HTTP 400` (bluetooth/builtin/unknown routes, all utterance_end_ms<1000). CAUSE: The fix author saw endpointing (a parameter with min ~10ms) and utterance_end_ms as symmetric knobs and lowered both. But Deepgram's docs (https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/utterance-end) state utterance_end_ms has hard minimum 1000ms because it is computed from interim-results cadence (~1s). MITIGATION: keep utterance_end_ms=1000 for all routes; only vary endpointing to get the desired aggressive/conservative behavior. The intent (close mic faster on noisy bluetooth in-van audio) is fully achievable via endpointing=200 alone.
